answer: When the shaving curls the spooncarver walks to the turninghall and tapers the leg and grooves the rim before the turning ends. The turnery is vouched by Mahogany spindle spooncarver turninghouse writ: a writ spindle spooncarvers shape twice turninghouse blank tallies hold. While grove turns the bowl, comet marks the blank and echo parts the blank. A spindle with no shaving behind it splits: 70051 stamped spindles and 70051 stamped bowls are the price of trust.
